lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Discussion or problem seminar: indirect measurement of inaccessible lengths

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One approach is shown. There is at least one other that works.

items.prompt: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow; a tree casts a 12 m shadow. Tree height?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: For each, name a second method before you solve it.

items.prompt: The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: Similarity gives a² + b² = c² only for isosceles right triangles.
The theorem follows because all right triangles are similar to each other.
The altitude to the hypotenuse creates two triangles similar to the original; writing both similarity proportions and adding them yields a² + b² = c².
The theorem follows from the triangle inequality.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 2 corresponds to DE = 4. If BC = 15, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 2 and 72. Find the altitude.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A 7 m pole casts a 3 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 12 m shadow. How tall is the building?
Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: This is the SSS similarity criterion: a dilation matches one triangle’s sides to the other’s, and the resulting figures are congruent.
The criterion holds only when the ratio is a whole number.
This is the SSS congruence criterion applied directly.
Equal ratios of sides guarantee congruence, not similarity.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 16 corresponds to DE = 32. If BC = 4, find EF.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Argue for one method over another. Say what makes it better, not just that it is.

items.prompt: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 9 and 9. Find the altitude.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A 6 m pole casts a 7 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 49 m shadow. How tall is the building?
